channel.description: Recent content in Glossary on SoloOpsGuide

item.title: Client Dependency
item.description: Use this definition to clarify what counts as a client dependency and why delayed inputs or approvals quietly stall delivery, billing, and closeout.

item.title: Next Action Owner
item.description: Use this definition to clarify who owns the next move in a workflow and why stalled handoffs usually reflect missing next-action ownership.

item.title: Approval Owner
item.description: Use this definition to clarify who can approve what in a workflow and why projects slow down when that role stays vague.

item.title: System of Record
item.description: A system of record reduces handoff errors by ensuring one authoritative place for client workflow state.

item.title: Workflow Handoff
item.description: Use this definition to understand what a workflow handoff should include and why weak handoffs create rework, delays, and missed details.
